channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Time-Series Models in the Streamhouse: A New Frontier and Use Cases
item.description: IBM's time-series foundation models, with more than 50 million downloads, are now natively integrated into Confluent for cloud and on-premises deployment on CPUs, using Apache Flink SQL to forecast and detect anomalies in streaming data. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
item.description: Google's Gemini app now runs on lower-memory Android Go edition devices, bringing Gemini Live conversations in more than 45 languages and Nano Banana image generation to those phones. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: Security risk assessments run automatically on GitHub Team
item.description: GitHub Team organizations now run free security risk assessments automatically, letting admins and security managers review findings on exposed credentials and code vulnerabilities to understand current risk and prioritize next steps. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Codex CLI 0.170.0
item.description: Codex CLI 0.170.0 adds GPT-6.2 Astra for hardest projects like implementing and testing changes across existing codebases, plus GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday coding and writing, with Pro $200 unlocking Sol's Ultrafast and Pro $500 both models. (OpenAI Codex Changelog)

item.title: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI partner to bring Le Figaro journalism to ChatGPT
item.description: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI will bring Le Figaro’s current reporting and archive content into ChatGPT as summaries, excerpts and links to the original articles, with plans to deploy ChatGPT Enterprise across the group. (OpenAI News)

item.title: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit with Transformers
item.description: For a 180B MoE on 32GB of RAM, llama.cpp, vLLM and Transformers are compared: Transformers copies an entire layer’s experts per token though only 8 to 10 are used, while streaming experts from SSD lands within 6% of Strata. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
item.description: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models (OpenAI News)

item.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol now available
item.description: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are generally available in GitHub Copilot for agentic coding and code review, and in early testing both caught significantly more real code issues than earlier GPT-6 models while using fewer tokens. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Rumble-2-Flash: an open 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
item.description: Rumble-2-Flash is a 0.5B-parameter Apache 2.0 speech recognition model covering 40+ languages, with a 6.96% average error rate on multilingual tests that beats Meta's 15x larger omniASR-LLM 7B and rivals models 3-60x its size. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Salesforce has had enough as employees burn cash on Tokens, rolling out role-based AI usage budgets
item.description: Salesforce employees ran up monthly AI token costs in the thousands of dollars last quarter, prompting COO Miguel Milano's internal memo setting role-based monthly token budgets from this month, with no company-wide individual cap and team leaders managing them. (AIbase)

item.title: Masayoshi Son admits mistake: not investing in Anthropic was a big miss — "I really wish we had invested.
item.description: SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son said at a Tokyo event on Wednesday that missing an early Anthropic investment was a mistake, and after meeting Dario Amodei he wished he had backed it, though SoftBank was already heavily invested in OpenAI. (AIbase)

item.title: Tencent WorkBuddy Marks Its Anniversary With 10M Daily Active Users and 100 Trillion Tokens Consumed Per Day
item.description: Tencent's Q3 2026 earnings report puts WorkBuddy at over 10 million daily active users as of early November, with more than 100 trillion tokens consumed daily and 100-plus major updates since its March launch. (AIbase)

item.title: Tencent Q3 Earnings: WorkBuddy Ranks No. 1 in China for Daily Token Usage, Cloud Revenue Up 35% YoY
item.description: WorkBuddy averaged more than 100 trillion tokens per day in the third quarter of 2026, ranking first in China, as Tencent's cloud revenue grew 35% year on year and Hy4 debuted atop Agent Arena's China model leaderboard. (AIbase)

item.title: More banks say customers using AI agents are on their own — even if they get hacked
item.description: Citi is the latest major bank to pump the brakes on personal-finance AI agents, while multiple institutions say customers who use agents to operate accounts bear liability even if hackers break in, shifting risk to users. (TechCrunch AI)

item.title: Musk publicly calls out Altman, saying SpaceX will never sell compute to OpenAI
item.description: Elon Musk said on X that SpaceX sells zero compute to OpenAI, rebutting Sam Altman's claim that chipmakers overestimate demand and double-count orders and arguing that slow OpenAI demand growth would signal a product problem. (AIbase)

item.title: Anthropic launches beta linked billing on Claude platform, closing the ecosystem loop and opening OAuth billing tests for third-party apps
item.description: Anthropic launched a beta linked-billing feature on Claude and began OAuth billing tests for third-party apps, tying external calls to user accounts and billing to pave the way for plugin, tool and service commercialization. (AIbase)

item.title: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol — Two new OpenAI models: frontier Astra and efficient Sol
item.description: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 release headline names two models, frontier Astra and efficient Sol, but the page currently serves only a CAPTCHA security check, with no body text loaded. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Artex Is Criminals’ New Favorite ‘Point-and-Shoot’ AI Hacking Tool
item.description: Artex, an open-source Go framework released by Autumn-27 on GitHub in July, has been used since late August in AI attacks on companies, government agencies and banks, letting novices run intrusions in hours via natural-language prompts that once took days. (Wired AI)

item.title: punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers — A collection of MCP servers.
item.description: The punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers GitHub repository gathers MCP servers into a single collection, and its page invites developers to register an account to contribute their own entries. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: Microsoft AI: Seven new world-class models that are scalable and cost-effective
item.description: Microsoft AI: Seven new world-class models that are scalable and cost-effective (microsoft.ai)
